cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're using my old packing method. Almost. Let me wrap that jam before you zip the case.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's already wrapped in my jumper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your train jumper. I did teach you to keep something warm within reach. We'll have to unpack it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave the jam here. Problem solved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've learned to simplify. Now taste it before you decide what to leave behind; I'll get two spoons.

reason: Preserve the useful Drive exchange while replacing generic training prefaces with specific corrections, qualified praise and claimed influence that make the mentor role determine A's tactic.
